messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['This is to inform all staff/student of our New security updates need to be performed on our servers, due to the rate of phishing.', 'We apologize for any inconvenience caused due to a recent upgrade to the Cornell University website and email service.', 'Chase Online has implemented multiple layers of security for your Internet Banking and is continuously upgrading it to protect you from online frauds as our customer.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'A Ransomware virus was detected in your email folders, please click to upgrade to our new Secured Avast antivirus 2017 version to prevent damages to our web mail log and other important files.', 'Due to technical reasons, please we are expanding and upgrading all Staff Mailbox immediately.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We upgrade websites, email, servers, and banking systems, strengthen security against phishing and fraud, and expand mailboxes to protect users and data."}
